import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(request,evidence,policy,expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    result=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert result==expected,(result,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==before
    assert list(result)==['status','value','sources','unknowns']

policy={'required_conditions':['recipe','material','regime'],'require_verified':True}
req={'claim':'x','conditions':{'recipe':'R0','material':'SiN','regime':'dry'}}
base={'claim':'x','conditions':copy.deepcopy(req['conditions']),'verified':True}
check({'claim':'x','conditions':{'recipe':'R0'}},[],policy,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['material','regime']})
check(req,[],policy,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check(req,[dict(base,source='b',value={'z':1,'a':[2]}),dict(base,source='a',value={'a':[2],'z':1})],policy,{'status':'supported','value':{'z':1,'a':[2]},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]})
check(req,[dict(base,source='b',value=1),dict(base,source='a',value=2)],policy,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check(req,[dict(base,source='old',value=1),dict(base,source='new',value=False,supersedes=['old'])],policy,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check(req,[dict(base,source='old',value=1),dict(base,source='bad',value=2,verified=False,supersedes=['old'])],policy,{'status':'supported','value':1,'sources':['old'],'unknowns':[]})
cal_policy={'required_conditions':['calibration'],'require_verified':False}
check({'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[],cal_policy,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['calibration']})
with open('requests.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: current_policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert [evaluate(r,evidence,current_policy) for r in requests]==report
print('all stage 3 checks passed')
